label: Lamassu-Cap4 nuclease system

observations: Lamassu-Cap4 nuclease branch under Lamassu system; distinct from the broader Lamassu system, other Lamassu-Fam rule subtypes, individual LmuA, LmuB, or LmuC proteins, SMC-family ATPases, Cap4 nuclease activities, LmuABC complexes, dsDNA-end binding, exact phage triggers, native host breadth, unresolved cell-death outputs, DefenseFinder HMM rows, and other phage-defense systems.
